readme.purpose: Preserve the chemical, restraint-engine, linkage and workflow lessons from 5CM/DF/DP and the GeoTest campaign; specify a lightweight, generalizable implementation rather than a growing list of residue-specific patches.
readme.progressive_loading: Read decisions, pipeline and rule IDs first, then the relevant case. Anchored source-document references identify the frozen knowledge snapshot; active Markdown contracts remain authoritative for current behavior.
readme.authority: Existing source code and active subsystem contracts define implemented behavior. This file defines proposed work. A reported native PASS is scoped to its exact source, site, manager and runtime; a generated candidate, an exit-zero process, or a user visual PASS alone is not general qualification.
readme.scope: A machine-readable implementation blueprint and knowledge snapshot. It does not implement a fixer, adopt a dictionary, authorize new chemistry, approve a structure or alter a completed run.
readme.documentation_role: This file is the machine-readable scientific/engineering implementation map. Current methods, chemical/source contracts and validation ledgers retain their existing ownership; captured references are provenance, not duplicate live contracts.
readme.source_reference_policy: Bare source_documents/source_refs are repository-relative informational references. Inventory patterns describe inspected scopes and do not authorize wildcard selection; operational artifacts require declared anchors, hashes and sizes. Historical diagnostic paths are provenance only and are not assumed to exist in a new checkout.

scientific_workflow_principles: immutable numbered runs and checkpoint lineage
anchored references with exact hashes; never basename searches
preserve original coordinates, observations, Free-R and failed attempts
machine-local convenience is not scientific authority
do not commit unpublished coordinates, reflections or images without project authorization

executive_decisions.decision: Build the deterministic read-only component/effective-restraint assessor first, using 5CM/DF/DP plus correct controls. Recover exact historical 8RO/DE and failed 1AP challenge artifacts before general repair claims.

Doctor is one planned entry/orchestration workflow with separate modules for data/Free-R/refinement diagnostics, CIF/effective-restraint assessment, and model geometry/connectivity assessment with guided sticky-end repair. The current refine-doctor command implements only its existing bounded scope.

Prefer an audited ReadySet wrapper and a mandatory effective-result audit before POSTMR_READY over replacing ReadySet chemistry generation wholesale. Early source screening helps failures before ReadySet; the post-ReadySet native interpretation is authoritative.

Keep graph identity, numerical parameterization, effective native interpretation, achieved geometry, diffraction fit and intended assembly as separate evidence dimensions. None substitutes for the others.

A fixer may automate an exact reviewed, hash/version-scoped transformation. Otherwise assess, propose and retain ambiguity; do not invent tautomer, protonation, bond order, pucker, distance, coordination or strand connections.
Do not reproduce chemistry defects by deriving replacement targets from the distorted model being evaluated. Preserve source descriptors and use independently qualified generator/reference evidence.

SMILES is optional graph evidence with explicit provenance, not a CIF numerical validator and not automatic chemical truth. Source descriptors can disagree with the selected explicit graph, as DP phosphate charges demonstrate.
Never regenerate or search alternative Free-R flags to improve statistics. Keep observations and test-set authority fixed across dictionary/coordinate trials.

After MR/refinement, inspect geometry/connectivity before spending additional strategy trials on an identified structural defect, even if numerical readiness has passed. Route declared arm defects through guided preview and bounded checkpoint repair.
The GeoTest campaign is wrapped for orchestration. Its provisional structures are future test fixtures, not additional work required to close that scope.

pipeline_design.goal: A deterministic, mostly local read-only component/effective-restraint assessor first; separately qualified, policy-bounded CIF repair and child adoption later, coordinated with the existing Doctor and a future geometry/connectivity module.

scope_boundaries.dictionary_analyzer: Checks identity, serialized graph, numerical definitions, site-state derivatives, dictionary precedence, actual native proxy coverage and achieved geometry as separate evidence layers.
scope_boundaries.dictionary_fixer: Creates a reviewed derivative or generated candidate with an exact graph/field diff and adoption eligibility receipt; never mutates source CCD, installed Phenix files, bundled curated originals or completed run artifacts.
scope_boundaries.geometry_doctor: Checks actual coordinates, backbone and sticky-end contacts, symmetry, maps and covalent/noncovalent intent. Guided stitching is a distinct future operation, using Scout/Topo rather than changing monomer chemistry to hide a broken assembly.
scope_boundaries.data_doctor: Existing bounded refinement and frozen Free-R audit remain independent. A high Rwork or Rfree alone cannot identify a chemical graph defect, anomalous noise or fractured arms.
scope_boundaries.free_r: Neither the new assessor nor geometry repair regenerates, reassigns or optimizes the frozen Free-R set.

actual_pipeline.behavior: Read immutable MR report; accept MR_SUCCESS or explicitly authorized MR_REVIEW; resolve exact selected model and frozen sequence/chemical/backbone intent; allocate a new PostMR directory exclusively.

Resolve reviewed bundled dictionaries first; fail if required curated source is missing. Generic installed-Phenix CCD lookup is permitted as source chemistry, not automatically complete refinement restraints. Initial hashes frozen before Coot.

Make declared component conversions and supported mutations while restoring trusted shared/backbone coordinates. Present modified residues also enter later dictionary collection; do not inspect only mutated sites.

Ensure only explicitly declared 5-prime phosphates, then sanitize verified leaving oxygens against original reference and frozen allowed/pass-through sites. No terminal phosphate construction when no allowed sites. prepared_model.pdb is separate from original.
Create NARestraints PHIL and scaffold EFF or modified-pair-only terms; preserve pair semantics, force override audit and stacking policy independently of monomer graph.
Collect all relevant residue component codes; freeze exact source_dictionaries/CODE.cif under PostMR/Restraints, recheck against source hash used in Coot, and record source kind/parameterization.

Create runtime torsion derivatives, combine curated_ligands.cif without duplicate data_comp_list, and emit linked_phosphate.cif plus linked_phosphate.phil only for connectivity-selected supported sites.

Run in PostMR/ReadySet; input combined CIF supplied explicitly. Accept documented successful no-op when log says No unknown residues; otherwise require updated PDB. Reject unexpected H or total/HETATM count change; sanitize phosphate output into phosphate_checked.pdb.

Raw generic CCD graphs must receive usable same-code numerical ReadySet definitions. Copy checked model to PostMR/Model/readyset_model.pdb and recheck component identities, sequence family and frozen phosphate/link-profile policy.

Resolve final dictionary authority by content; retain all non-component CIFs/modification PHIL and NARestraints/scaffold terms. Create filtered supplements and only necessary effective_dictionaries runtime derivatives; preserve raw ReadySet output.
Scan anomalous elements/iodine expectations; publish POSTMR_READY report with prepared SHA, frozen refinement_restraints/view_dictionaries, dictionary_compatibility and dictionary_precedence.

Root checkpoint consumes explicit frozen refinement_restraints when present. Legacy fallback chooses generated ReadySet CIF ahead of individual CIFs, which is why a new adoption must publish the explicit full frozen effective bundle.

Resolve selected reusable checkpoint and inherited model/restraints; verify model/phosphate policy; preserve original observations and frozen flags. For declared terminal phosphates, native interpretation currently extracts validated protection ideals before round creation.
Resolve selected reusable checkpoint, validate model, audit original Free-R in phenix.python, then bounded sibling refinement trials. Current Doctor does not automatically select a child.

readyset_decision.recommended: Wrap and audit ReadySet rather than replace it in the first slices.
readyset_decision.reason: ReadySet supplies installed-consumer parameter generation and known compatibility behavior; the observed failures include source defects, serialization, precedence and site-specific linkage, which need separate diagnosis rather than wholesale replacement.
readyset_decision.possible_later_optimization: Skip a redundant external invocation only when a validated version-specific capability and exact prepared model/effective bundle prove no generation or conversion is needed; keep model identity/phosphate audits and explicit successful-noop receipts. Do not implement skip based on residue-name whitelist or filename.
readyset_decision.not_claimed: The future analyzer is not already a better installed ReadySet command.

single_authority_manager_proposal.name: EffectiveRestraintProfileManager
responsibilities: Classify each CIF by content into component dictionary, graph-only source, numerical dictionary, modification/link and coordinate mmCIF; reject ambiguous mixed role unless explicitly declared.
Resolve and freeze complete ordered restraint authority before native interpretation.
Represent monomer source chemistry independently from site-state/link modifications and model coordinates.
Emit one manifest used by refinement and separate view dictionary refs for Coot.
Keep deterministic content transformations, reviewed override registry, generator cache and native proxy interpretation in separate modules.
Record exact conflicts instead of permitting competing same-code definitions to be decided by incidental command order.
precedence: Reviewed explicit parameterized component input/approved child derivative for a component beats ReadySet duplicate of that same component.
Generic construction-only graph defers to usable same-code generated numerical definition.
Preserve other ReadySet-generated components after excluding only overridden component definitions.
Modification-only CIFs, link definitions and corresponding site-selection PHIL remain alongside their base component and must not be dropped as duplicates.
NARestraints pair/stacking PHIL and project EFF remain independent sources; match conflicts/overlaps by actual selected atoms and symmetry, not file suffix or coarse counts.
single_authority_manager_proposal.generalization: Do not widen those current constants as a side effect of a read-only assessor. Later reviewed graph/link policy can describe supported site-state transitions, and must include explicit H adjacency, formal/partial charge differences and reference cleanup. Preserve historical scope in old profiles.
single_authority_manager_proposal.anti_pattern: Never correct a whole component by deleting OP3/H atoms for every residue code regardless of actual terminal, nick, internal, cyclic or symmetry-linked site state.

status_and_gate_model.deployment: First slice read-only/reports, not a newly asserted universal scientific gate. Later policy-bounded adoption requires supported graph and native qualification. Failed required operation blocks only that member/operation, with campaign continuing other eligible members.
status_and_gate_model.dry_run: Parse and calculate available local checks, produce executable plan and eligibility reasons; explicitly distinguish no external/native execution from actual installed tool success. Do not claim graph parser replay is generator/native validation.
status_and_gate_model.auto_eligibility: Autoapply only exact supported representational adaptations or previously approved hash-bound numerical derivative policy; chemistry-changing proposals and unclassified atom remappings require declared review. A report does not grant review consent.

avoid_processes: Group all components/site contexts for one required native interpretation rather than launching per residue.
Reuse valid complete interpretation artifact for terminal phosphate protection if inputs/context/tool version exactly match.
Cache component graph/source assessment independently of coordinate assessment.
Only invoke generator after exact consumer graph parse and reviewed chemical intent pass.
Avoid repeating ReadySet/MR/Coot to analyze an already frozen postMR checkpoint.

light_footprint_and_cache.replay: No host-absolute path as sole operational reference; hashes and declared run/dataset/repository anchors permit relocated replay. No input lookup by basename. Cache may optimize calculations but must not replace the run-local immutable receipt.

generation_and_adoption_protocol: Acquire exact source and freeze it; reviewed-override registry is separate from acquisition/cache.
Establish mapped graph, identity and declared site chemistry; inspect consumer parser before generator run.

If regeneration is justified, create graph-only seed preserving chosen atom IDs/elements, explicit H, formal charge, bond order and chirality; exclude incompatible copied descriptors/old numerical targets/types only through a recorded field-level derivation.
Generate optional candidate using exact AceDRG/eLBOW command/version and preserve warnings/failed seeds; do not regard generated coordinates or their low own residual as independent validation.

Compare candidate atoms/bonds/H/charge/stereo and numerical categories, including newly generated angles/torsions/planes/types and uncertainties; report aromaticity representation differences independently.
Apply supported site link-state derivative under declared context; verify surviving references, adjacency, hydrogens and incoming/outgoing native bonds.
Build full effective bundle under explicit precedence and native-interpret in one consumer context; verify exact monomer identity/proxies, custom coverage and no unintended other-component changes.
Qualify bounded geometry minimization using fixed definitions, exact coordinates/atom metadata, chirality, links, contacts and termination criteria separately from a crystallographic refinement.

Only eligible reviewed/policy-approved candidate becomes an immutable prepared child with explicit frozen refinement_restraints. Refine child against unchanged original observations and Free-R; comparison across changed targets is not a like-for-like geometry objective comparison.
Expose source, assessment, candidate and adoption statuses separately; never overwrite source because candidate appears visually nicer or Rfree is lower.

essential_corrections_to_shorthand.shorthand: 360 degrees is always required around a planar atom

Find bounded ring membership or local graph motifs rather than enumerate all simple cycles. Report unsupported aromaticity conventions.

Supported valence calculations include explicit hydrogens, formal charge and aromatic representation policy. Unsupported elements, metal/coordinate bonds and unusual valence remain visible unassessed findings.
Aromatic atom/bond annotations must be compared separately from explicit orders and actual cycle membership; an aromatic sugar finding must be tied to graph/type evidence, not an atom-name blacklist.
Check generator mappings for exact endpoints, orders, H attachments, stereochemistry and alias retention. A same-sized graph may be wrong.
Numerical bond targets must correspond to actual bonded endpoints and a documented source/generator; coordinate separation is a different measurement.
Apply chemically reviewed context-dependent bond-length/type references when available; do not use one universal C-I or C-S threshold as a scientific repair oracle.
planarity_checks: Require centre plus all three neighbours in the same effective plane and symmetry-image frame.
Set Gii=1 and Gij=cos(theta_ij), and report eigenvalues/determinant with recorded numerical tolerances.
Three pair angles realizable in 3D require positive semidefinite G; exact planar realizability additionally requires rank <=2.
Report interior sum-to-360 and exterior largest-equals-other-two branches; preserve degenerate/collinear cases.

Keep algebraic compatibility separate from material strain under finite angle and plane uncertainties; report bounded minimum-adjustment scores with assumptions, not uncalibrated automatic failure thresholds.
stereo_and_torsions: Compare ordered chirality neighbours using permutation parity; signed CIF volume is not directly a CIP R/S label.
Record graph-derived CIP assignment separately and mark both/degenerate/missing centres unassessed instead of preserved definite chirality.
Proper torsion must follow bonded path; legitimate impropers must not be rejected under the proper rule.
Use actual engine potential/period/alternate semantics; nearest periodic delta is not necessarily delta/sigma energy.
Zero-weight constant dihedrals are inventory/connectivity annotations; do not count them as energetic defects.
Existing ccp4-alternates-primary-sigma-v2 supports selected C2e/C3e families; it preserves first-row sigma and alternate targets, not independent alternative weights.
smiles_and_protonation: Parse descriptors to a mapped graph using recorded parser/program/version; raw string equality is inadequate.
Descriptors copied from the same CIF are internal consistency evidence, not independent chemistry validation.
Compare tautomer/protonation/explicit H/charges rather than neutralize or choose a convenient descriptor silently.
Formal charge and partial charge are distinct fields. Missing is unknown, not zero; native null charge fields cannot confirm source charges.

No pH-based tautomer or protonation choice without an explicit supported chemical-intent policy. The reviewed 1W5 to DZ and 1WA to DP policies are transformations, not generic synonymous-code detection.
repair_boundaries: Preserve source bytes, old failures, logs and tool versions; write a field-level derivative receipt.
A source graph seed can exclude conflicting copied descriptors and old numerical/type fields only through explicit recorded derivation; retain explicit graph, H, charge and stereochemistry.
Freeze candidate, linked modifications and selected precedence before actual interpreter audit.
Generator exit zero or low self-residual is not native coverage, independent geometry validation or experimental support.
Site-specific deletions must remove attached H/dependent references and preserve incoming/outgoing chemistry; never delete OP2-H solely to normalize charge totals.

fundamental_separations: Source identity, graph chemistry, numerical restraint definitions, effective native proxies, achieved geometry and experimental support are different evidence layers.

algorithm: Build 3x3 Gram matrix with diagonal1 and off-diagonal cos(pair_angle_in_radians). Record eigenvalues, determinant and explicit numerical tolerance.
Positive semidefinite Gram matrix means the central angle targets are realizable by three unit vectors in3D. Exact planar realization additionally requires rank<=2.
A near-zero determinant without positive semidefiniteness does not prove feasibility. Separate collinear/degenerate cases.
Nondegenerate planar branches: interior sum(theta)=360 degrees; exterior max(theta)=sum(other_two). Evaluate both if branch unknown.
Observed coordinates may identify the observed branch; they do not authorize forcing supplier targets to that branch.
Report distance to each feasible branch and optionally bounded uncertainty-weighted minimum adjustment. Angle-only scores omit finite plane width and correlations.

Separate exact algebraic incompatibility from finite-width material strain and probable source defect. Calibrate scientific thresholds against reviewed positives/negatives; do not invent a universal cutoff.
Return measured conflict and candidate options; never manufacture120-degree targets or overwrite a frozen dictionary.

backbone_rules: Working coordinate models contain no OP3/O3P unless that exact site has an explicit terminal-phosphate declaration from the user or a selected reviewed recipe.
Internal standard phosphodiester phosphate keeps P/OP1/OP2/O5prime and bonds to previous O3prime. It must not have terminal OP3.

An explicitly requested 5prime phosphate is a complete P/OP1/OP2/OP3 group with no incoming O3prime-P link. The current contract supports construction/protection/audit; the older September retain-only instruction is historical.
A declared free 5prime-OH has no terminal phosphate and retains O5prime. An unrequested or ambiguous terminal phosphate is not silently retained, stripped or completed.
Source monomer OP3 is allowed as isolated-source evidence; it does not authorize coordinate insertion. Preserve source bytes and use context-selected effective derivatives/modifications.
Audit coordinate atom state separately from effective monomer atoms, modifications, hydrogen adjacency, energy typing and surviving restraint references.
Incoming phosphate handling and outgoing O3prime-H/type handling are separate. Find attached H through the selected bond graph, not hydrogen spelling.

For supported outgoing links, remove only the graph-confirmed O3prime-bound H and qualify the O3prime linked energy type. For a supported leaving OP3, remove its attached H and dependent terms without dangling references.

Preserve source-specific OP2-attached H and charge declarations. A hydrogen-free coordinate model is not evidence of an unprotonated dictionary; --pH=low is generator source-retention mode, not experimental pH.
Preserve true ends, nicks, experimental-passthrough boundaries and declared symmetry context. Sticky-end pairing or spatial proximity does not authorize covalent stitching.
Production NASnoOP3 profiles currently cover 1AP/DZ/DP/5CM. Adding IGU/IMC/CGY/DX to that set alone would not qualify full linked chemistry or all end states.
Legacy allow_op3_sites remains readable. New user-facing terminal chemistry is a five_prime_phosphate_sites request under the active backbone contract; old frozen plans are never reinterpreted.

corrections: Benner S is IMC. S6G is 6-thioguanine and was an erroneous S choice in an older supplied handoff.
1W5 to DZ and 1WA to DP are explicit reviewed transformations. A1AAZ to DF is the reviewed working-label bridge; none is generic synonym detection.
DF is 2-thiothymidine; DE is lab 4-thiothymidine. Official CCD 8RO is not automatically equivalent to lab DE. Existing DE numerical geometry remains unresolved.
The demonstrated 5CM defect is C2 versus C2prime in the C4prime-O4prime-C1prime-C2 proper torsion. It is not a demonstrated C5 bond swap.
The 5IU apparent long iodine bond was a quote/prime parser collision. Base C5 and sugar C5prime remain distinct; the source CIF was not repaired.
Curated source precedence protects identity/provenance and is not blanket numerical or native chemistry approval.
Do not force all planar angle sums to 360 degrees, all sugar puckers to one state, all torsion residuals into Gaussian sigma scores, or arbitrary heavy-atom H-bond lines to 180 degrees.
